name: shmat
synopsis: void *shmat(int shmid, const void *_Nullable shmaddr, int shmflg);
description: shmat() attaches a System V shared memory segment identified by shmid to the address space of the calling process, allowing specification of the attachment address and flags. It updates segment metadata upon success and automatically detaches at process exit.

parameters.name: shmid
parameters.description: Identifier of the shared memory segment to attach

parameters.name: shmaddr
parameters.description: Address for attachment; NULL for system-chosen address, or page-aligned otherwise

parameters.name: shmflg
parameters.description: Flags for attachment, such as SHM_RND, SHM_RDONLY, SHM_EXEC, or SHM_REMAP

return_value.success: Returns the address of the attached shared memory segment
return_value.failure: Returns (void*)-1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The calling process lacks required permissions for the attach type
shmid points to a removed identifier
Invalid shmid, unaligned shmaddr, or cannot attach at shmaddr
Could not allocate memory for the descriptor or page tables
